message.content: Let me look at the `dn_expand` implementation and the `NS_GET16`/`NS_GET32` macros:

content:
#define NS_GET16(s, cp) do { \
        const u_char *t_cp = (const u_char *)(cp); \
        (s) = ((uint16_t)t_cp[0] << 8) \
            | ((uint16_t)t_cp[1]) \
            ; \
        (cp) += NS_INT16SZ; \
} while (/*CONSTCOND*/0)

#define NS_GET32(l, cp) do { \
        const u_char *t_cp = (const u_char *)(cp); \
        (l) = ((uint32_t)t_cp[0] << 24) \
            | ((uint32_t)t_cp[1] << 16) \
            | ((uint32_t)t_cp[2] << 8) \
            | ((uint32_t)t_cp[3]) \
            ; \
        (cp) += NS_INT32SZ; \
} while (/*CONSTCOND*/0)

#define GETSHORT                NS_GET16
#define GETLONG                 NS_GET32

#define C_IN 1
